callees.name: _is_under_submodules
callees.pre_condition: source_file is a string representing a file path; submodules is a non-empty sequence of subdirectory path strings
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if the source_file path, after normalizing directory separators, begins with the path prefix of at least one entry in submodules (after the same normalization). Returns False when source_file does not reside within any of the specified submodule directories.
